dispositions.statement: Coder 2.34.6 is the current reviewed upstream release. The binary is confined to fixed coder ssh helper and loopback port-forward argv against the trusted private Coder service; the application exposes no arbitrary Coder CLI or remote-command route, and those fixed flows do not select the affected dd-trace-go route. This exact record is accepted only while upstream remediation is monitored.

Coder 2.34.6 currently embeds Go 1.26.4. The binary is confined to fixed coder ssh helper and loopback port-forward argv against the trusted private Coder service; the application exposes no arbitrary Coder CLI or remote-command route, and those fixed flows do not select the affected standard-library route. This exact record is accepted only pending an upstream rebuilt release.

The control plane includes x/crypto OpenPGP transitively through go-git, but no application path invokes the affected OpenPGP functionality. The post-upgrade govulncheck run reports zero symbol and imported-package vulnerabilities and only this uncalled required-module record. This exact no-fix record requires review again by the expiry date.

The pinned unmodified Coder binary is intentionally distributed under AGPL-3.0 and its exact license file is retained in the scratch image. This is a time-bounded engineering disposition, not legal advice.

The exact EnvBuilder binary embeds Docker 28.5.2 client modules but contains no Docker daemon or AuthZ execution path affected by this finding. Docker 29.3.1 is the recorded fix, but that major-version path is not compatible with the pinned upstream EnvBuilder release; this exact record is accepted only until the expiry review.

The exact EnvBuilder binary contains Docker client-side dependencies but no Docker daemon archive/containerExtractToDir implementation or call path affected by this finding. The frozen database records no fixed version and no compatible remediation exists on the pinned upstream path; this exact record must be reviewed again at expiry.

The exact EnvBuilder binary contains Docker client-side dependencies but no Docker daemon docker-cp bind-mount implementation or call path affected by this finding. The frozen database records no fixed version and no compatible remediation exists on the pinned upstream path; this exact record must be reviewed again at expiry.

Source analysis of the exact EnvBuilder binary found no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp import or OpenPGP call path; its Git handling uses the ProtonMail OpenPGP fork instead. Govulncheck therefore reports this as module-only with no called affected package or symbol. The frozen database records no fix, so this exact record must be reviewed again at expiry.

The exact helper binary includes x/crypto transitively, but no called application path reaches the affected OpenPGP functionality. The frozen govulncheck result is module-only with no called affected symbol; this exact no-fix record must be reviewed again at expiry.

The exact transitive npm package node-path-is-inside is permissively licensed under WTFPL. Its retention is accepted for this exact build only under a time-bounded engineering and license review; this is not legal advice and must be reviewed again at expiry.
